# `Q-20-2` — Pandoc Version Too Old

> The `pandoc` binary found on `PATH` reports a version older than the
> minimum this Quarto version requires.

## What this means

Quarto found a `pandoc` binary, but its reported version is below the
floor this Quarto release requires for the docx/pptx Pandoc-hybrid render
path. Older pandoc releases don't ship the Lua filter APIs (or bug fixes)
this path depends on, so rendering does not proceed.

## Why this happens

- Pandoc was installed some time ago and has not been upgraded since.
- A system package manager ships an older pandoc than the one this Quarto
  release was tested against.
- Multiple `pandoc` binaries exist on the machine, and `PATH` resolves to
  an older one.

## How to fix

Upgrade pandoc to the required version or newer — see
[pandoc.org](https://pandoc.org/installing.html) for platform-specific
install instructions. If multiple pandoc installations exist, check which
one `PATH` resolves to (`which pandoc` on macOS/Linux, `where pandoc` on
Windows) and either update `PATH` or set `QUARTO_PANDOC` to the newer
binary's path.
